meta.assumption: ATT&CK imposes no tactic ordering (register M3); every ordering here is imported from the lifecycle literature as an assumption of this work

models_overlaid.L3: Mandiant seven-stage via Alshamrani (secondary channel; stages 3-6 declared any-order)

stages.2: post-intrusion operations (weakly ordered internally, by consensus)

resolution_rules.R-1: ambiguity collapses into the unordered middle: a tactic whose position models dispute, or which any model treats as continuous rather than positional, seats in stage 2, which asserts no internal order
resolution_rules.R-2: individuation beats the catch-all: a finer APT-specific placement outweighs a seat derived only from the CKC Actions-on-Objectives catch-all or a definition-free convention cell

distance.delta: s(destination) - s(source); sign is semantic, never collapse to |delta|

backward.note: gentler than forward by design: falling back is ordinary, leaping far forward is what is suppressed

zero_floor.semantics: at fold-in, d < z reads as exactly 0
